notes.title: We want your feedback :)
notes.notes: [p][b]Ahoy captains![/b][/p][p]It's hard to think that a month already passed since the Sneaky Pirates release, it passed so fast! [/p][p]While we are currently working on adding new content to the game in a future patch coming in Q3, we are looking forward to hear your thoughts on the game. What you like, what you don't like, and what would you do to improve our game![/p][p]Here is [url="https://forms.gle/nEK3nxDHTbrMxqTA8"]the link to the form[/url], we will add your steam user name (if you provide it in the form) to the testers section of the credits :) [/p][p][b]See you in the open seas captain![/b][/p]

notes.title: Sneaky Pirates is available!
notes.notes: [p][b]Ahoy, captains![/b][/p][p]The time has come! Connect with your friends today and live the pirate life in [b]Sneaky Pirates[/b]. We're very excited to have made it this far and to finally share the first version of our game with you.[/p][p]But this is just the beginning — we have many ideas to explore and ways to expand the game. That’s why we need your help! We want to develop the game based on feedback from our players, so don’t forget to join our [b]Discord[/b], share your ideas, and why not, play together![/p][p]See you on the ocean, captain![/p]

notes.title: Demo available ahead of Next Fest!
notes.notes:
[b]Ahoy, captains![/b]

We are pleased to announce that you can now play the demo of Sneaky Pirates! We are very proud of the work done so far to reach this huge milestone, so thank you to everyone who supported the development, and also to those following Sneaky Pirates — we love you!

This marks the beginning of our participation in Steam Next Fest, a great opportunity to let everybody know about Sneaky Pirates. So remember to spread the word — Sneaky is just around the corner! Get ready to sail the seven seas with your friends (and steal from each other in the process).

[b]See you all soon![/b]

notes.title: Steam Deck and other platforms support!
notes.notes:
Ahoy Captain!

The last two weeks have been busy with lots of playtesting and feedback improvements on the game. A huge thank you to all our testers for the great feedback we’ve received! We will soon be sharing a new gameplay video showcasing some of the latest improvements based on your feedback.

In the meantime, we also wanted to let you know that we are working on getting the game running on as many platforms as possible, including the Steam Deck, which runs on a native Linux build!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45507171/61b3110be87ff8122a1f42efbbf3368ffc7e3d62.jpg[/img]

See you soon on the open seas, Captains!

notes.title: Gameplay Trailer released!
notes.notes:
Ahoy, Captain! We’re working hard to prepare for the release of Sneaky Pirates in Q2 2025! In the meantime, Nico, our lead developer, has prepared this video explaining the game mechanics and how to play. We also plan to do playtests during this time, so be sure to wishlist the game to stay updated on when they’ll be happening. We hope ye enjoy it! See ye soon, matey!
